The waist portion supporting region is longer in the seat width direction than the coupling region.

outputs.L3:
The disclosure relates to a vehicle seat frame provided with a compact waist portion supporting member capable of stably supporting the waist region of an occupant seated in the vehicle seat.

The vehicle seat frame includes a seat cushion frame, a seatback frame, and a waist portion supporting member. The seat cushion frame forms a structural frame of a sitting portion of the vehicle seat on which the occupant is seated. The seatback frame forms a structural frame of a backrest portion that supports the back of the occupant. The seatback frame includes a lower frame, and the waist portion supporting member is coupled to this lower frame.

The waist portion supporting member is configured to support the waist or lumbar region of the occupant from behind or below, thereby improving seating stability and comfort. The waist portion supporting member includes a coupling region and a waist portion supporting region. The coupling region extends in the seat width direction and is coupled to the lower frame of the seatback frame. By extending in the seat width direction, the coupling region can be securely attached to the lower frame while maintaining a compact structure.

The waist portion supporting region extends from the coupling region toward the seat cushion frame. This waist portion supporting region is configured to contact or support the occupant’s waist region when the occupant is seated. The waist portion supporting region is wider than the coupling region in the seat width direction. As a result, the waist portion supporting member can provide a broad support surface for the occupant’s waist while keeping the coupling region compact. This configuration allows the waist portion supporting member to stably support the occupant’s waist without requiring a large or complicated structure.

Accordingly, the disclosed vehicle seat frame achieves both compactness and stable waist support. The coupling region enables reliable attachment to the seatback frame, while the wider waist portion supporting region improves support performance for the occupant’s waist region.
outputs.L4:
A vehicle seat frame includes a seat cushion frame and a seatback frame connected to the seat cushion frame. The seatback frame has a lower frame portion, and a waist portion supporting member is coupled to the lower frame portion so as to support the waist or pelvic region of an occupant seated on the vehicle seat.

The waist portion supporting member includes a coupling region and a waist-supporting region. The coupling region is attached to the lower seatback frame and serves as the portion through which the waist portion supporting member is fixed or supported. From this coupling region, the waist-supporting region extends downward or forward toward the seat cushion side, so that it can be positioned behind or near the occupant’s waist when the occupant is seated.

The waist-supporting region is formed to have a greater width than the coupling region. By making the supporting surface wider at the area that contacts or supports the occupant, the member can provide stable support to the occupant’s waist while maintaining a relatively small attachment area at the seatback frame. This configuration allows the waist portion supporting member to be compact and lightweight, while still ensuring sufficient support performance and occupant comfort.

As a result, the seat frame can improve support around the lower back or waist of the occupant without requiring a large supporting structure. The reduced size of the coupling region also helps simplify the structure around the lower seatback frame and may contribute to improved layout flexibility, easier assembly, and reduced weight of the vehicle seat.
outputs.L5:
**The Power of “The”**

“The” is one of the smallest and most common words in the English language, yet it plays an important role in how we communicate. It is called a definite article, and we use it when we are talking about something specific or already known. For example, when we say “the book,” we are not talking about any book, but a particular one.

Although “the” may seem simple, it helps make sentences clear and precise. It points the listener or reader toward a certain person, place, object, or idea. Phrases like “the sun,” “the world,” and “the truth” feel complete because “the” gives them focus and meaning.

In writing, small words often carry great importance. Without “the,” many sentences would sound incomplete or unnatural. This tiny word helps organize language, connect ideas, and guide understanding. It reminds us that even the simplest parts of speech can have a powerful effect.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent-style abstract for a vehicle seat frame invention where a compact lumbar/waist support member attaches to the lower seatback frame and has a wider support region extending toward the seat cushion.
counterfactuals.output: A vehicle seat frame includes a seat cushion frame and a seatback frame coupled to the seat cushion frame. A lumbar or waist support member is mounted to a lower portion of the seatback frame. The support member is configured as a compact bracket or panel having an attachment portion fixed to the seatback frame and a support portion extending downwardly or forwardly toward the seat cushion. The support portion includes a widened support region relative to the attachment portion to distribute load over an increased area at a lower back or waist region of an occupant. The widened support region may be positioned adjacent a junction between the seatback and the seat cushion to improve occupant support while maintaining a reduced package size and simplified mounting structure. The support member thereby enhances lower back support and seating comfort without requiring a large or complex lumbar mechanism.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a concise “present disclosure” description of a vehicle seat frame including a seat cushion frame, seatback frame, and waist portion supporting member coupled to a lower frame, with the supporting region wider than the coupling region.
counterfactuals.output: The present disclosure relates to a vehicle seat frame including a seat cushion frame, a seatback frame coupled to the seat cushion frame, and a waist portion supporting member coupled to a lower frame of the seatback frame. The waist portion supporting member includes a coupling region coupled to the lower frame and a supporting region configured to support a waist portion of an occupant. A width of the supporting region is greater than a width of the coupling region, thereby improving support for the occupant’s waist while enabling compact and stable attachment to the lower frame.

counterfactuals.prompt: Generate a patent abstract for an automotive seat structure that stably supports an occupant’s waist using a smaller waist support member connected to the lower portion of the seatback frame.
counterfactuals.output: An automotive seat structure includes a seatback frame and a waist support member provided at a lower portion of the seatback frame for supporting a waist region of an occupant. The waist support member is formed smaller than the seatback frame and is connected to the lower portion of the seatback frame so as to be stably held in position during occupant seating. The waist support member may extend in a width direction of the seatback and project forward relative to the seatback frame to receive and support the occupant’s lumbar or waist area. By arranging the smaller waist support member at the lower portion of the seatback frame, the occupant’s waist can be reliably supported while reducing the size and weight of the support structure, thereby improving seating comfort and occupant posture stability.
counterfactuals.label: cf_3

counterfactuals.prompt: Summarize an invention for a car seat frame: the lumbar support member is attached to the lower frame of the seatback, includes a seat-width coupling region and a wider waist-support region extending toward the cushion, and is designed to be compact yet stable.
counterfactuals.output: The invention describes a compact, stable car seat frame with an integrated lumbar support member. From this coupling region, a wider waist-support region extends toward the seat cushion to support the occupant’s lower back/waist area.
